historical_reviews.v3_1: The F4 response is not sufficient: the intended value must persist, the expected exit path must complete, and no unrelated configuration may change.

original_test_intent: Verify that F4 saves one explicitly approved reversible BIOS change, exits Setup through the expected path and preserves only the intended value after reboot or return.
original_method: Identify and record one safe pending change and its old/new values, capture the Setup context, press F4 once, accept only the approved confirmation, supervise exit/reboot, verify persistence and restore baseline if the plan requires it.
manual_activity: A human operator must confirm the exact pending change, press F4, assess the save prompt and supervise exit/reboot; automation may only preserve and correlate the supplied evidence.
required_inputs: Owner-approved reversible setting and old/new/baseline values
Expected F4 prompt and exit/boot path
Validated pre-OS input/capture and independent OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Exclude boot/security/storage/network/power changes unless separately authorized
Press F4 once and accept only the expected prompt
Verify intended persistence and unrelated-setting invariance
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Report without performing F4 or issuing the verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the reversible change, save/reboot and recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects ordinary SSH as the interaction path but does not define what is saved or how persistence and boot recovery are proven.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain one operator-driven F4 Save & Exit action for the pinned reversible change, followed by exact post-boot value verification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: F4, Save & Exit and 5/5-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a single approved low-impact setting with complete before/pending/saved/restored values and timestamped Setup-to-boot capture.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a deterministic change oracle, persistence proof and recovery boundary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; the function key, save and exit behavior remain required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: F4 can persist every pending change, not only the intended setting, and may immediately reboot.

project_override_considerations: A project must nominate the setting and decide whether restoration is part of the same run; a generic F4 screen response cannot replace persistence and boot evidence.
expected_evidence: Host/console/row identity and approved setting path
Approval, prompt reference and recovery readiness
Timestamped F4, confirmation and exit/reboot capture
Post-boot saved-value readback and unrelated-setting diff
Baseline restoration or approved retained state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target F4 Save & Exit; the unspecified change is a readiness input, not a conflicting source identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The save/exit purpose is clear; the exact reversible setting, approval and recovery are finite project inputs.

review_improvement: Converts an unspecified persistent F4 action into a bounded setting write with explicit prompt, reboot, readback and restoration evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: F4 can persist all pending BIOS changes and reboot the host, so contextual human control and approval are indispensable. Evidence processing is automatable, but the test action itself remains MANUAL ONLY.
